facts.fact: 他看她恐慌发作却忍住不出手：吞食她的渴望只需一个念头就能抽干她的惊慌——但他不能、也不愿。
facts.anchor: To feed on the longing that radiates from her like heat would require the smallest effort.

facts.fact: 她的第一世截然不同：笑声像夏花草甸上的庙钟，会织布、作画、塑陶——「那是在认识我之前」；每一轮生死循环，她的光都在变暗。
facts.anchor: She was not always like this: a fragile creature trembling on the floor of a cold apartment that holds nothing of her essence.

facts.fact: 他自报神格：Aakanksh，渴望之神——以凡人未遂的欲望为食（丧子的母亲、被夺所爱的恋人、窥见完美却抓不住的艺术家）；尝遍众生渴望，唯独「Never Maven’s. Never hers.」
facts.anchor: I am Aakanksh, God of Longing.

facts.fact: 最大揭示：她每一次自杀尝试，他都在前一刻抽走她的绝望，让冲动消散——她以为「缺勇气」，「I let her believe this. It is kinder than the truth.」
facts.anchor: Each time she has tried to end this life—lifting blade to wrist, swallowing pills by the handful, stepping toward one-way destinations with deadened eyes—I have taken her longing in the moment before.

facts.fact: 神界设定：大战后 Bright Gods 给六位 Dark Gods 各许配一个灵魂（安抚/贿赂）；「事故」让灵魂投进凡人子宫——自由意志选择加入才能回家；Vorin（暴食神）已先收回他的。
facts.anchor: The Bright Gods offered a soul to each of the six Dark Gods after the Great War

facts.fact: 本世的她=「最暗的一版」Maven Talmay（27 岁、八年九城、寄养幸存者）——灵魂被流放磨到「忘记怎么认出快乐」，但最初的本质仍在呼唤他。
facts.anchor: This Maven—Maven Talmay, twenty-seven years old, resident of nine cities in eight years, survivor of foster homes and countless rejections—is the dimmest iteration yet.

facts.fact: 白纱=保护性显形：神之真容会烧毁凡人神智；他看得见她的每一根睫毛，她只能看见白丝——「The Nameless God」则以旋涡黑暗示人。
facts.anchor: Maven sees me draped in white silk that obscures my features, though I feel nothing on my face.

facts.fact: 她没叫他走、没否认他的存在；他与她的呼吸不自觉同步——本世第一次「希望展开」：「This time will be different.」但今夜只给「presence without demand」。
facts.anchor: For the first time in this mortal lifetime, hope unfurls in me.
